_comment: Core journey: change the arrival date after reaching the berth list. Its first step is the seeded CW-Q2 failure (the only way back to the dates is inside the More options menu).
title: Change the arrival date while choosing a berth

persona.group: Skippers of visiting cruising yachts who have not used this harbour before
knows: the new day they now plan to arrive, one day later than first entered
that they are part way through booking
does_not_know: where the booking keeps the dates once they are past the first page
that a menu button holds more actions
persona.context: Weather has changed the plan; they are on the list of berths and want to move the arrival by a day

goal: See which berths are free for the new arrival day without starting again
scenario: You were about to book a place for Saturday 17 October 2026, but the forecast means you will now arrive on Sunday 18 October instead, still around three in the afternoon. Make the booking use the new day.

start_state.data: all four visitor berths are free on 17, 18 and 19 October 2026
